messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: mężczyzna (formy męskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Montuje rolety na zlecenie w Pabianicach; krótkie wpisy wrzuca między dojazdami do klientów.
- zainteresowania: parzenie kawy w kawiarce, porządkowanie kabli, bilard
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: parking przy ulicy Zamkowej w Pabianicach
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Odnawia stary stolik i wciąż dobiera do niego odpowiedni lakier.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: urwane zdania, prawie bez kropek; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: heavy; emoji: no
- tik językowy: pisze „no i cyk”

For each of the 19 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. drobne narzekanie na usługi - serwis samochodu (late morning, Friday)
2. sport - skoki narciarskie / siatkówka / żużel w TV (early morning, Wednesday)
3. praca i grafik - wypłata, premia, rozliczenie (evening, Monday)
4. sport - rower, trasa weekendowa (early morning, Wednesday)
5. zwierzęta - spacer z psem (morning commute, Thursday)
6. sport - bieganie, pierwsza 5/10 km (afternoon, Tuesday)
7. gry i seriale - wieczór z planszówkami (late morning, Thursday)
8. dzieci i rodzina - dziadkowie, telefon (early morning, Saturday)
9. zwierzęta - spacer z psem (afternoon, Sunday)
10. technologia i sprzęt - aktualizacja telefonu (morning commute, Tuesday)
11. drobne narzekanie na usługi - serwis samochodu (evening, Monday)
12. jedzenie i gotowanie - grill, ognisko (early morning, Sunday)
13. zwierzęta - kot i jego humory (lunch break, Tuesday)
14. remont i dom - malowanie pokoju (evening, Tuesday)
15. praca i grafik - przerwa, kawa, stołówka (lunch break, Monday)
16. jedzenie i gotowanie - nowy przepis, eksperyment (morning commute, Saturday)
17. jedzenie i gotowanie - bar mleczny / pierogi / kebab (late night, Thursday)
18. praca i grafik - szef / współpracownik, drobna sytuacja bez konfliktu (early morning, Monday)
19. gry i seriale - zakup na promocji na Steamie (early morning, Thursday)

Return a JSON array of 19 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
